data-model.text: Fields, relationships, validation and state invariants of the new or changed data. Signatures are in the functions model. Output ceiling: 6 KB.

journal-data-command-line-pull-request-2.text: At a fold's rolled-back line the restored public root is the first transition's root before.

receipt-data-command-line.text: The earlier single-request fields (request, key, edge, liveOutput, envelope, released, deposit) describe the one settled request of a fold of one. In pull request 1 they stay at the top level of the receipt, unchanged, and the lists (settled, excluded, the capacity bound with its provenance) are added beside them, so that no existing reader changes while main stays green; the lists repeat the settled request in the shape of the table above. In pull request 2 the readers move to the lists and the top-level duplicates are removed in the same change. Readers of the receipt are listed in the plan.

pull-request-3-at-e7b55ac9.text: A settled entry holds one request's key, edge, owner, kind, delivery and deadline. A fold's journal line always carries the list of transitions, and its scalar fields mirror the first and the last transition; a line whose scalars disagree with its list is not observed.
